title: Venue A - Overview
text: Venue A is a corporate event space located in Hinjewadi, Pune, with a maximum seating capacity of 80 people in theatre-style arrangement and 40 people in a boardroom arrangement. The venue includes a projector, a PA system, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Base rental cost is INR 25,000 per day, inclusive of standard furniture and lighting.

title: Venue A - Capacity Details
text: For workshops specifically, Venue A recommends a maximum of 35-40 participants to allow for group breakout activities. Rooms can be reconfigured within 30 minutes between theatre and workshop-table layouts. Advance booking of at least 7 days is required for capacity above 30 people.

title: Venue B - Overview
text: Venue B is located in Kharadi, Pune, and offers a flexible open-plan hall suitable for workshops, seminars, and product launches. Maximum capacity is 100 people theatre-style, 50 people workshop-style with round tables. Base rental cost is INR 35,000 per day.

title: Venue B - Capacity Details
text: Venue B's workshop-style layout comfortably accommodates 30 people per round table configuration, with a total hall capacity of 50 people when using 5 round tables of 10 each, or up to 60 people using 6 tables of 10 with tighter spacing. A minimum 10-day advance booking is required.

title: Venue A - Cancellation Policy
text: Bookings for Venue A can be cancelled free of charge up to 14 days before the event date. Cancellations made between 7 and 14 days before the event incur a 25% cancellation fee. Cancellations made within 7 days of the event incur a 50% cancellation fee, and no refund is issued for cancellations within 48 hours of the event.

title: Venue B - Cancellation Policy
text: Venue B offers a more flexible cancellation policy: full refund if cancelled 10 or more days before the event, 50% refund if cancelled between 5 and 10 days before, and no refund for cancellations within 5 days of the event date. All cancellations must be submitted in writing via the booking portal.

title: Refund Processing
text: Approved refunds for both Venue A and Venue B are processed within 10 business days to the original payment method. Refund requests must include the original booking confirmation number. Partial refunds due to cancellation fees are calculated based on the base rental cost only and do not include add-on service charges.

title: Catering Options - Standard Package
text: The standard catering package for workshop events includes morning tea/coffee, a mid-morning snack, a buffet lunch with 2 vegetarian and 1 non-vegetarian option, and afternoon tea/coffee with light snacks. Pricing for the standard package is INR 850 per person for full-day events.

title: Catering Options - Premium Package
text: The premium catering package adds a live counter (choice of pasta, chaat, or dosa station), an expanded buffet with 4 vegetarian and 2 non-vegetarian mains, and dessert options. Pricing for the premium package is INR 1,400 per person for full-day events. Both packages can accommodate dietary restrictions with 48 hours advance notice.

title: External Catering Policy
text: Venue A allows external catering vendors with a corkage fee of INR 5,000 per event, provided the vendor is registered and FSSAI-certified. Venue B does not permit external catering under any circumstances and requires use of their in-house catering partner exclusively.

title: AV Equipment and Technical Support
text: Both venues include a standard projector and screen, a wireless microphone set (2 handheld, 1 lapel), and a PA system as part of the base rental. On-site technical support is available for an additional INR 3,000 per day at Venue A and is included at no extra cost at Venue B.

title: Parking and Accessibility
text: Venue A offers on-site parking for up to 40 vehicles, free of charge for event attendees. Venue B has limited on-site parking (15 vehicles) but is located near a public parking structure within a 5-minute walk. Both venues are wheelchair accessible with ramp access and accessible restrooms.

title: Booking Process
text: To book either venue, submit a request through the online booking portal at least the minimum advance notice period required (7 days for Venue A, 10 days for Venue B). A 20% advance payment is required to confirm the booking, with the balance due 3 days before the event.

title: Group Workshop Best Practices
text: For workshops with breakout group activities, event planners recommend allocating at least 2.5 square meters per participant to allow comfortable movement between group tables. Groups of 6-8 participants per table tend to produce the most effective collaborative outcomes for half-day and full-day workshops.

title: Weather and Seasonal Considerations - Pune
text: Pune experiences a moderate climate for most of the year, with monsoon season from June to September bringing heavy rainfall. Event planners scheduling outdoor components of workshops in Pune during monsoon months should have an indoor contingency plan and confirm covered parking access.

title: Weather and Seasonal Considerations - General
text: For workshops scheduled between October and February, Pune's climate is generally dry and mild, making it a preferred period for corporate events with any outdoor networking components such as garden receptions or rooftop sessions.

title: Corporate Discount Programs
text: Companies booking 3 or more events per year at Venue A or Venue B qualify for a corporate partnership discount of 10% on base rental costs. This discount does not apply to catering or add-on services and must be requested at the time of initial booking.

title: International Attendee Considerations
text: For workshops with international attendees, both venues can arrange visa invitation letters with 5 business days notice. Venue A additionally offers airport pickup coordination for an extra fee of INR 1,500 per attendee, while Venue B does not offer this service.

title: Insurance and Liability
text: Event organizers booking either venue are required to carry event liability insurance covering a minimum of INR 10,00,000. Proof of insurance must be submitted at least 3 days before the event. Venues do not provide event insurance coverage themselves.
